scope: Standalone open-source directory on the same Windows x64 machine; no model weights copied into this directory

default_tests.note: Uses the existing working Python environment, with this repository as the test root; asset-dependent integration tests explicitly skipped

ci_subset.command: python -I -m pytest -q -m "not integration and not font"
ci_subset.note: Executed in the newly created source-directory virtual environment; subset of default tests, not additional unique tests
